@graph.headline: n8n Review: Features, Pricing and Limits
@graph.description: A research-based n8n review covering workflow features, AI nodes, pricing, licensing, self-hosting, limits and the teams most likely to benefit.

itemListElement.name: n8n Review: Features, Pricing and Limits

acceptedAnswer.text: It can be worth using for technical teams that need visual workflows, APIs, code and deployment choice. It is less attractive if nobody owns maintenance or if the licence does not fit the product you want to build.

The self-hosted Community Edition is available without a software subscription for uses allowed by its licence. You still need infrastructure and maintenance. n8n Cloud offers a trial, not a permanent free Cloud plan.
n8n source is published under the Sustainable Use License. That licence is not OSI-approved open source, so check the exact terms for internal, commercial and customer-facing use.
The current documentation lists n8n 3.0 as early access and says self-hosted deployments need Docker-based installation for that version. Review the migration guide before upgrading.

mainEntity.name: Does n8n charge for every node?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. n8n Cloud counts a full workflow run as one execution, regardless of how many steps it contains.
